integrity: Analytic proof reconstructed with exact moment identities and explicit inequalities; finite checker is supplementary and is not an infinite-dimensional certificate.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for real exponents alpha>-1 and the analytic unit-disk Bergman space with the exact weight (-log|z|^2)^alpha. It does not count all zeros, treat multivariable spaces, or prove robustness for perturbed weights. Integer polylogarithm cases were established previously. Independent historical priority and mathematical audit have not occurred.
title: Sharp zero-free threshold for logarithmic radial Bergman kernels
